title.en: Read and analyse an opinion text
title.es: Leer y analizar un texto de opinión

es: Leer un texto de opinión e identificar su tesis, los recursos que la apoyan, los conectores y el grado de certeza que expresa el autor.

teaching.en: The writer's thesis is that cities should close their centres to cars.
teaching.es: La tesis de la autora es que las ciudades deberían cerrar sus centros a los coches.
teaching.explanationEs: La tesis es la idea principal que el autor defiende; suele aparecer al inicio o al final.
segments: The writer's thesis is that cities
should close their centres to cars.
teaching.audioText: The writer's thesis is that cities should close their centres to cars.

teaching.en: She supports her thesis with a statistic: air pollution fell by a third.
teaching.es: Apoya su tesis con un dato: la contaminación del aire bajó un tercio.
teaching.explanationEs: Los recursos (datos, ejemplos, citas) sostienen la tesis: pregunta con qué la apoya.
segments: She supports her thesis with a statistic:
air pollution fell by a third.
teaching.audioText: She supports her thesis with a statistic: air pollution fell by a third.

teaching.en: However, critics point out that shops may lose customers.
teaching.es: Sin embargo, los críticos señalan que las tiendas podrían perder clientes.
teaching.explanationEs: However marca contraste; may deja abierta la posibilidad, sin afirmarla.
segments: However, critics point out that
shops may lose customers.
teaching.audioText: However, critics point out that shops may lose customers.

teaching.en: This will probably help, but it could also cause new problems.
teaching.es: Esto probablemente ayudará, pero también podría causar nuevos problemas.
teaching.explanationEs: Los matizadores muestran la certeza: will es seguro; probably y could dejan margen.
segments: This will probably help, but it
could also cause new problems.
teaching.audioText: This will probably help, but it could also cause new problems.

teaching.en: In fact, the evidence seems to suggest a clear trend.
teaching.es: De hecho, las pruebas parecen sugerir una tendencia clara.
teaching.explanationEs: In fact refuerza lo dicho; seems to suggest suaviza la afirmación.
segments: In fact, the evidence seems
to suggest a clear trend.
teaching.audioText: In fact, the evidence seems to suggest a clear trend.

teaching.en: Therefore, the writer concludes that the plan is worth trying.
teaching.es: Por lo tanto, la autora concluye que el plan merece la pena.
teaching.explanationEs: Therefore introduce la conclusión, que suele cerrar el texto.
segments: Therefore, the writer concludes that
the plan is worth trying.
teaching.audioText: Therefore, the writer concludes that the plan is worth trying.
